newsitem.title: USA: Russia debt reconciliation still seen Aug - finmin.
newsitem.headline: Russia debt reconciliation still seen Aug - finmin.

text.p: Russia still hopes to finalize the reconciliation of its debts to the London Club of commercial bank creditors by August, Deputy Finance Minister Oleg Vyugin said on Tuesday.
"We have said that it should all be cleared by August and we are still aiming at that," he told Reuters.
Reconciliation of the debts is essential to complete the rescheduling of Russia's London Club debts. It clarifies how much Russia owes to each individual bank creditor.
